description: This Dart file defines the HomeActivity widget which serves as the main navigation shell for a Flutter application. It manages a scaffold with an app bar and a navigation drawer containing various menu items. The file handles drawer item selection, display of user information, and loading different fragments corresponding to each menu item.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the main activity with navigation drawer, custom app bar, and dynamic body content based on menu selection.

classes.name: _HomeActivityState
classes.description: State class managing the drawer state, user info display, and fragment switching logic.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes user display name and email from widget properties or preferences.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the main Scaffold with AppBar, Drawer, and body content.

methods.name: _buildDrawer
methods.description: Builds the navigation drawer widget with header and menu items.

methods.name: _buildBody
methods.description: Returns the widget corresponding to the currently selected drawer item.

methods.name: _onDrawerItemTapped
methods.description: Updates selected drawer index and drawer title; closes the drawer.
